responsibility: Implements the general directed-graph support used as structured diagnostic metadata, especially for SARIF and GraphViz output. This file owns cloning, JSON/SARIF conversion helpers for graph/node/edge objects, property-bag attribute access, unique edge-id generation, and conversion of nested diagnostic graphs into .dot graphs, thereby providing the concrete behavior behind diagnostics::digraphs abstractions rather than the state-graph specialization layered on top.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for the digraphs pair: it defines graph cloning, property-bag accessors, SARIF/JSON conversion helpers, GraphViz .dot conversion, edge-id generation, and the digraph selftests. In contrast, digraphs.h declares the digraph/node/edge object model and public methods.
